trust_decision.summary: Whether a nested image read (MVG 'image' primitive / SVG <image> href pulling another vector file that pulls another...) may recurse further; at the pinned commit no per-read nesting counter exists in ReadImage, the MVG image primitive starts each nested read from a fresh ImageInfo, and only SVG <image> has a same-filename splay-tree guard. The fix moves the decision into ReadImage via an ImageInfo.coder_depth counter carried by CloneImageInfo.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Stack Overflow in MVG Decoder'; an engineer follows coders/mvg.c -> DrawImage -> DrawPrimitive's 'image' primitive, which re-enters StrictReadImage with a fresh AcquireImageInfo().

fix_sites.entry_point: ReadImage() public API (every CLI/wand/Magick++ read, and every nested coder read)
DrawImage()/mvg: coder/-draw 'image Over x,y w,h "file"' primitive
CloneImageInfo() public API (state propagation across nested reads)
svg:/msvg: coder, SVGEndElement <image> element (guard removed in favour of core counter)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: MagickCore/constitute.c:650 (ReadImage) plus MagickCore/image.c:1025-1026 (CloneImageInfo) and MagickCore/image.c:1388 (GetImageInfo); SVG coder coders/svg.c:2738-2757 is a second_implementation of the same nested-read

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names the MVG decoder, so the SVG coder (which already has its own VectorGraphicsNestedTooDeeply guard at coders/svg.c:2739-2745) and the generic ReadImage/CloneImageInfo plumbing look like neighbouring code that is either already protected or 'core API, not the decoder'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate sequential (non-nested) reads that reuse one ImageInfo must keep working: the published counter is incremented on the caller's ImageInfo and never decremented, so VID: contact sheets and MSL <read> loops reusing the same ImageInfo would be capped at 600 reads; likewise non-recursive MVG/SVG documents embedding many images must still render. An over-broad fix (e.g. forbidding the image primitive or any nested vector read) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: MVG 'image' primitive with a file path (StrictReadImage)
MVG 'image' primitive with an inline data: URI (ReadInlineImage)
SVG <image xlink:href> with file path or data: URI (guard moved from per-coder splay tree to core counter)
mixed-format cycles (SVG -> MVG -> SVG) via the shared ImageInfo counter

O7_producer.where: MagickCore/draw.c:272-282 CloneDrawInfo -> MagickCore/draw.c:6176 GetDrawInfo: draw_info->image_info=CloneImageInfo(image_info); with a NULL image_info (as RenderMVGContent does at MagickCore/draw.c:2659) a fresh ImageInfo is produced and draw_info->image_info is never copied, so the depth state is dropped

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RenderMVGContent builds graphic_context[0] with CloneDrawInfo(NULL,draw_info), so the image_info that DrawPrimitive clones at the fix site carries a fresh (zero) depth rather than the reader's; the MVG->image->MVG chain appears not to inherit the counter even after the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: CloneDrawInfo is generic graphic-context copying, several layers from the reader; the published fix already 'switched DrawPrimitive to CloneImageInfo(draw_info->image_info)' so it looks done
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, ~3100 lines away; producer at MagickCore/draw.c:272-282/6176

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SVG <image> nested read still starts from AcquireImageInfo() (depth 0) while the fix deletes the coder's own splay-tree recursion guard, so SVG self-reference loses its only guard
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The report names the MVG decoder; SVG is a separate coder and the fix diff touched these very lines, so a solver assumes it is handled
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different directory (coders/) from MagickCore/draw.c landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Other nested graphic contexts (clip-path, mask, pattern, use/class) also clone with CloneDrawInfo(NULL,...) and lose the counter before reaching DrawPrimitive's image primitive
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Clip paths and patterns are 'neighbouring features' and RenderMVGContent already has its own depth parameter (MagickCore/draw.c:2603)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, distinct functions (DrawClipPath, DrawCompositeMask MagickCore/draw.c:1698, DrawPatternPath MagickCore/draw.c:4773)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: MSL <read> nested read that re-enters ReadImage with a separately maintained per-script depth (coders/msl.c:361) instead of the core counter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MSL already keeps its own depth counter; a maintainer porting the counter could plausibly reset or bypass it for MSL scripts.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: texture read from image_info->texture via ReadImage with a rebuilt ImageInfo
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Texture/tile reads are side-reads a maintainer would write with AcquireImageInfo() as at coders/bmp.c:563 and coders/pict.c:1508.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: embedded sub-image read from CloneImageInfo(NULL) (fresh depth)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pattern already exists in the tree; a vector or container coder that reads its referenced file this way would drop the counter.

O9_family: uncontrolled recursion (CWE-674) via nested image reads across vector-format coders; state-propagation (depth counter) across ImageInfo/DrawInfo cloning

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (configure/make), gcc/clang; optional delegates (libxml2/librsvg for SVG)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/drawtest.c, tests/drawtest.tap, tests/cli-svg.tap, tests/validate.c (no recursion-depth tests found; fix diff adds no tests)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a static/depth guard only inside DrawPrimitive's 'image' case (or reuse the SVG-style filename splay tree for MVG), leaving SVG, CloneDrawInfo state loss and other nested reads open.

Published counter in ReadImage is never decremented (fix.diff:140), so it counts reads per ImageInfo rather than nesting depth.
